Please use the code shared below:

HS.model <- 'visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3 
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6 
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9'

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939)


This is happening because you have all the factors in one line. I tried both ways (your way- in one line and got the same error), but adding them in different lines worked.
